text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's it for today's concert! If you liked the show, try to remember my name, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: As if we'd forget! Keep up the good work, Falcooo!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehe! Thanks, everyone! See you at the next performance! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Today's performance was electric! It was like they couldn't stop shouting my name!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Falco fever is spreading like wildfire! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …Or is that a bit much?
choice_data_list: There's no doubt you're getting a lot of attention.

text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon has been steadily securing victories. As proof of her popularity as a rising star on dirt…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Blog?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Whoa, this blogger specializes in dirt races? That's pretty rare. Let me see…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "I used to only care about the races themselves, but Smart Falcon has shown me the true potential of the winning concerts."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "I'd like to wrap up this weekly review by expressing my gratitude for everything she's doing. Good luck on becoming a top Umadol, Falco!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Whoa!
choice_data_list: Looks like "Umadol" is starting to catch on.
Looks like "Umadol" is starting to catch on.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe… I hope so.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It wasn't that long ago when my fanbase was small enough to count.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Now I've got all these people cheering for me all of a sudden.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Everyone has such high hopes for me, so I want to work really hard…
choice_data_list: Gotta become a top Umadol, huh?
Gotta become a top Umadol, huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's right!
On our way back to campus…

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan A
text_block_list.text: Whew! Another great performance! Falco really brings the heat when she's in the center!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey, I think those two people were at my performance!
choice_data_list: Do you want to talk to them?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm off the clock now, after all. Now, if they were to approach me, then I'd pull out all the stops and—

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan B
text_block_list.text: But it's kind of a shame, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan B
text_block_list.text: If she's aiming to be the top on dirt, that means she probably won't be running the Classic Triple Crown, right?

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, I guess not. I mean, she probably chose dirt because she doesn't have the aptitude for turf.

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan B
text_block_list.text: But don't you want to hear someone with her kind of energy sing "Winning the Soul"?

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I know what you mean. Imagine how hype it would be seeing her up on stage at the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan B
text_block_list.text: Exactly! Falco would look so cool spinning the stand mic.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh, r-right… We should head back too!
